metadata.description: Claude Code mods. Add this marketplace, then install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: thai-translate
plugins.description: /thai en: Thai prompts go to Claude in English, replies shown in Thai. /thai cn: Thai/English prompts go in Chinese, replies shown in the language you typed. Only messages after turning it on are translated.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Start a prompt with "++ " and haiku writes a brief (goal, constraints, unknowns, done-check) for Claude. /enhance ask shows it for approval first; /enhance auto sends right away.

plugins.name: final-message
plugins.description: System-prompt rule: Claude keeps text between tool calls to a one-line status and puts every finding, answer and decision in the final message.

plugins.name: agent-tracker
plugins.description: Agents pane (open from session start) showing what the main thread, subagents and teammates are doing, plus True/False cards for Claude's logged assumptions. /tracker, /assumptions.

plugins.name: workflow-editor
plugins.description: Your editable workflow rules (~/.claude/workflow.md) injected into Claude's system prompt; Workflow pane open from session start, or /workflow-edit.

plugins.name: workflow-rail
plugins.description: Plan > Build > Prove > QC > Report band above the prompt. Needs home/.claude/hooks/qc-gate.sh from this repo for the QC status.

plugins.name: header-tray
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: live subagents/teammates and your newest artifacts (click to preview). /tray toggles.
